// path: Scan authored package and tooling implementation. Centralized tests remain outside CPD; scripts/ contains operator, research, probe, and one-shot codemod programs rather than the durable tooling package.
// formats: The languages in play. `tsx` is REQUIRED to see the client — jscpd's `typescript` format does NOT tokenize .tsx, so without this every .tsx source is invisible to the gate.
// minLines: 5 lines minimum — below this it's coincidence.
// maxLines: 20000 — NOT a block cap, a whole-FILE SKIP threshold (jscpd never scans a file over this many lines at all; measured with planted 2500-line fixtures, #1330). Raised above the largest authored source file (packages/contracts/src/preset/index.ts, 3253 lines) so no scanned source file is invisible to the gate; the generated/oversized-file bail-out this comment used to describe is maxSize + gitignore + the migrations/snapshots/d.ts ignores below.
// threshold: CI gate: fail if duplication exceeds 2%. RATCHETED 5->2 (2026-07-16, derive-program close): measured floor after W1-W6 = 1.38% lines / 1.68% tokens (tsx 0.80%) - the next copy-paste CLASS reds instead of accumulating. Re-ratchet toward the floor as it drops.
// ignore: The centralized tests/ tree is outside the configured roots. Migrations and DevTools assets are generated/vendored; fixtures and snapshots are data; declarations are not implementation.
// ignorePattern: Ignore import blocks that are naturally identical across files.
// ignoreCase: Ignore case of symbols in code to catch stylistic renames.
// reporters: Console for interactive use; `pnpm cpd:report` emits the HTML to reports/cpd.
// noTips: Suppress sponsor/AI tips in CI output.
